findings.finding: setInterval invokes async callback every2500ms without waiting for previous promise; health→refresh→showRun may overlap
findings.causal_limit: Overlapping request possibility is proved by code; no causal attribution of PG timeout, lock/queue/CPU delay is proved.

findings.finding: Each refresh increments runHistoryGeneration. Overlap invalidates old refresh output, but does not stop previously issued HTTP GETs.
Explicit history refresh directly calls refresh; should remain outside background busy guard.
Project change clears existing evidence and generations, then explicitly refreshes. Preserve this path; do not reset busy early during identity/project changes.

minimal_contract: One backgroundBusy flag acquired synchronously before first await; return immediately when busy. Wrap complete health→refresh→showRun sequence in try/catch/finally; finally is only release point.
Guard background interval only; do not add guard to refresh/showRun themselves or prevent explicit user refresh.
No queue/catch-up tick, no immediate self-call in finally, no automatic POST or accepted-intent retry. Next scheduled interval may do ordinary GET reads.
Keep existing current/generation checks and metadata failure invalidation. Never restore stale evidence or clear pending accepted-body/key maps to improve performance.
Do not clear busy on identity/project switch; old work must settle and finally release. Explicit switch refresh remains allowed.
Coalescing does not bound a permanently unsettled fetch; this is an honest remaining network-liveness boundary, not a reason to fake completion or relax90/150/900 timeouts.
required_oracles: Hold health unresolved across multiple synthetic interval firings: one background health call only. Resolve and next tick proceeds.
Hold refresh unresolved: later intervals add no background refresh/showRun; explicit refresh still starts independently.
Reject health, refresh, and showRun separately: catch behavior retained and next scheduled tick resumes after finally.
Token/project A→B→A during suspended work: existing clear/generation hooks still run; stale response cannot repopulate A old evidence. Do not early release backgroundBusy.
Metadata503/auth revocation: previous source/report/plan remains cleared; unchanged authorized metadata preserves current facts.
UNKNOWN/malformed accepted receipt remains same key and body; tick recovery never submits/retries POST. Count actual methods over repeated ticks.
Deferred source report text remains textContent-safe; no task success/semantic or owner approval changes.
Real loaded app.js hash and actual HTTP DOM recorded; keep90s budget; targeted finalcurrentPG run only if root authorizes.
execution_bounds: Readonly static analysis only; no product edits/test suite/PG/provider calls/network/server processes.
